g.text: One market, three curves. The PAR curve is what you are quoted.

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: The SPOT curve is what each single future dollar actually costs —

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: it sits ABOVE the par curve wherever the curve slopes up, because a

text.style: font-size: 10.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #555555

g.text: coupon bond's early payments are discounted at cheaper short rates.
